description_en: Queries node group information by calling GetNodeGroup
description_zh: 调用GetNodeGroup获取节点分组信息
name: GetNodeGroup

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the Alibaba Cloud Link WAN console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The node group ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109944.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 节点分组ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109944.html接口查询获取
parameters.name: node_group_id
